work.composition: full-figure tracing with collaged sculptural elements
work.description: Loose ink line drawing of a female torso occupies the full picture plane, with two spherical photographic breast forms collaged onto the chest area. Below, a chrome reflector lamp component is affixed at the lower center, surrounded by small drawn sun-like marks on white paper.
keywords: traced female body with photo collage
work.title: Untitled (Traced Female Torso)
